params.body:
Two fixes for the Android app (abovebeyond-ai/portal-android), found on the owner's phone.

**The passkey in the app.** Signing in from the app failed with Android's "RP ID cannot be validated": Play Services could not confirm that Portal trusts the app. `assetlinks.json` named the app under `delegate_permission/common.get_login_creds` only; Google's passkey guide gives `delegate_permission/common.handle_all_urls` beside it. `AndroidApps::assetLinks()` now names both, and `AndroidAppsTest` holds that.

**Every list the app reads is a list.** `MobileScreens` handed some lists over as they came out of a sort or a filter, with their old keys (a project's measurements and its setup items, the systems' jobs, the workbench's other projects, among others); `json_encode` writes such a list as an object keyed "3", "7", which a reader of lists cannot take. Every list now leaves renumbered (`values()`). The app (portal-android 0.3.2) also reads such an object as a list and never crashes on an answer it cannot read, so this is the server keeping its side of the contract.

Tests: 663 of 664 pass; `BuildStampTest` fails in a worktree checkout without this change as well. PHPStan and Pint pass.
params.title: Android app: both asset-link relations for the passkey, every list renumbered
